text: For $\lambda \in \mathfrak{h}^*$, the Verma module $M(\lambda)$ is constructed as the induced module:
explanation: $M(\lambda) = \mathcal{U}(\mathfrak{g}) \otimes_{\mathcal{U}(\mathfrak{b})} k_\lambda$ induces the $1$-dimensional Borel module $k_\lambda$ up to $\mathfrak{g}$. Swapping $\mathfrak{g}$ and $\mathfrak{b}$ is not induction; the Hom-form is coinduction over the wrong subalgebra; and as a vector space $M(\lambda) \cong \mathcal{U}(\mathfrak{n}^-)$ (built from lowering operators), not $\mathcal{U}(\mathfrak{n}^+)\otimes k_\lambda$.
